info.title: Nivult Job Postings & Company Intelligence
info.description: Direct Nivult API for active job postings and company records. Jobs and changes cost 1 credit per returned record, companies cost 3 credits, and empty results or managed errors cost 0 credits. Usage, coverage, export manifest and Daily Bulk are unmetered service endpoints; authentication, rate limits and entitlements still apply. Public demo endpoints are explicitly marked as anonymous.

get.description: Active postings with keyset pagination. Direct accounts pay 1 credit per returned job. q requires all search terms in title or description; q_any matches at least one of up to 15 comma-separated keywords. Keyword filters accept comma-separated OR values. Unknown query parameters are ignored.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; comma-separated values are ORed

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Job family; comma-separated values are ORed

parameters.name: ats
parameters.description: Source platform slug; comma-separated values are ORed. bundesagentur maps to bundesanstellung case-insensitively, token by token, also inside lists.

parameters.name: exclude_ats
parameters.description: Source slugs to exclude, with the same bundesagentur normalization as ats. If a slug appears in both parameters, directly or through the alias, exclusion wins.

parameters.name: seniority
parameters.description: intern, junior, mid, senior, lead or head; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: remote
parameters.description: remote, hybrid or onsite; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Posting language; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search over title and description; all terms are required (AND)

parameters.name: q_any
parameters.description: At least one comma-separated keyword must match title or description (OR); maximum 15. Can be combined with q.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Full-text search restricted to title; all terms are required (AND)

parameters.name: technology
parameters.description: Case-insensitive exact match against normalized technologies; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: source_type
parameters.description: direct, aggregator, staffing or public_board; comma-separated OR. Invalid values return 400.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Employer-name full text; all terms are ANDed

parameters.name: company_slug
parameters.description: Employer/source slug; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: company_domain
parameters.description: Employer domain; scheme, www and path are removed; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State/region; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: employment_type
parameters.description: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship or apprenticeship; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Exact source department; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: Exact extracted skills; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: salary_currency
parameters.description: Source salary currency; comma-separated OR

parameters.name: has_salary
parameters.description: Whether salary_min or salary_max is present. Other values return 400.

parameters.name: salary_min
parameters.description: Observed salary_min >= N; null values do not match. Invalid or negative values and inverted ranges return 400.

parameters.name: salary_max
parameters.description: Observed salary_max <= N; null values do not match. Invalid or negative values and inverted ranges return 400.

parameters.name: posted_after
parameters.description: Posted at or after this ISO 8601 date/timestamp (inclusive)

parameters.name: posted_before
parameters.description: Posted strictly before this ISO 8601 date/timestamp (exclusive)

parameters.name: dal
parameters.description: Legacy alias for posted_after, used only when posted_after is absent

200.description: A page of postings; X-Credits-Charged equals count_page

get.description: Company records keyed by ATS + company_slug. Direct accounts pay 3 credits per returned company. Filters are single-value and ANDed.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Exact country of the company record

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Exact industry value

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive company-name substring search

parameters.name: technology
parameters.description: Case-insensitive exact match on the company-level technology aggregate

parameters.name: employees_min
parameters.description: employees >= N. Negative, non-integer and inverted ranges return 400 with a string detail.

parameters.name: employees_max
parameters.description: employees <= N and >= employees_min when both are present. Negative, non-integer and inverted ranges return 400 with a string detail.

200.description: A page of companies; X-Credits-Charged equals 3 times count_page

get.description: Returns one full company object for 3 direct credits when found. Missing companies and managed errors cost 0 credits.

parameters.name: piattaforma
parameters.description: ATS/source identifier from the record's ats

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Employer slug within that ATS

200.description: The unwrapped company record; X-Credits-Charged is 3

headquarters.full_address: Via XX Settembre 1, 10121 Turin TO, Italy

example.description: Italgas operates gas distribution infrastructure and related digital services in Italy.

get.summary: Delta feed: new, updated and closed events
get.description: Delta history costs 1 direct credit per returned event and requires an active Growth subscription or higher with at least 100,000 credits/month. Default retention is seven days, but the effective boundary is metadata-driven.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp within retained history; missing or malformed values return 400

200.description: A page of Delta events; X-Credits-Charged equals count_page

400.description: Missing/malformed since, invalid cursor or expired retention; X-Credits-Charged is 0

get.description: Returns the latest export manifest for 0 direct credits, including at zero balance. Requires an active Scale subscription or higher with at least 500,000 credits/month.

200.description: Latest export manifest with API-relative download paths; X-Credits-Charged is 0

get.description: Downloads gzip JSONL for 0 direct credits. jobs and companies are recommended; offerte and aziende are fully backward-compatible aliases with identical content and filenames. Requires an active Scale subscription or higher with at least 500,000 credits/month.

parameters.name: nome
parameters.description: jobs/offerte download nivult-jobs.jsonl.gz; companies/aziende download nivult-companies.jsonl.gz

200.description: The gzip export; X-Credits-Charged is 0 and Content-Disposition contains the uniform filename

get.description: Returns fill-rate percentages from 0 to 100 measured in the latest export. Company fields are nested under aziende, never under company:* keys. Costs 0 direct credits.
Direct usage is account-wide across current and revoked keys. The recurring plan or one-time trial allowance is spent before purchased credits. Costs 0 direct credits and works at zero balance.

200.description: Current usage and balance; X-Credits-Charged is 0

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Two to forty accepted characters; invalid input returns 400

example.campione: demo pubblica anonima. I nomi aziendali sono disponibili nella API con chiave.

parameters.name: tipo
parameters.description: Legacy Italian sample selector; used when type is absent

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Recommended English selector; takes precedence over tipo

200.description: Gzip JSONL sample; filename is nivult-campione-offerte.jsonl.gz or nivult-campione-aziende.jsonl.gz

get.summary: Legacy alias for the anonymous sample export

200.description: Same gzip JSONL sample and filename as /v1/demo/sample-export

CreditsCharged.description: Actual direct credits charged by this request; 0 for empty pages and managed errors. Paid direct endpoints emit it on every response; unmetered service endpoints emit 0 on success.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait, present only when the 429 is a rate-limit response, never for credit errors

DownloadDisposition.description: attachment; filename="nivult-jobs.jsonl.gz" for jobs/offerte or attachment; filename="nivult-companies.jsonl.gz" for companies/aziende

PageLimit.name: limit
PageLimit.description: Requested page size. Direct accounts at or below 1,000 monthly credits are capped at 25 records/page, 2 requests/second and burst 5. Higher-volume accounts use up to 500 records/page, 15 requests/second and burst 30. Available balance divided by per-record cost can further lower the effective limit.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor copied unchanged from next_cursor; invalid cursors return 400

PaidBadRequest.description: Invalid date, cursor, source_type, has_salary, salary/employee bound or range, or more than 15 q_any terms; X-Credits-Charged is 0

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key

PaidUnauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key; X-Credits-Charged is 0

PaidForbidden.description: Required Delta entitlement is missing; X-Credits-Charged is 0

NotFound.description: Requested company, export or sample is not found

ValidationError.description: FastAPI typed parameter validation failed, for example limit=0 or a non-integer limit

PaidValidationError.description: FastAPI typed parameter validation failed; X-Credits-Charged is 0. Salary and employee-range errors use 400 instead.

PaidTooManyRequests.description: Rate limit, exhausted credits or insufficient credits for one result. Retry-After is present only for rate limits; credit errors have an object detail and must not be retried automatically.

RateLimited.description: Request frequency exceeded the key or IP rate limit; no credits are charged

DemoRateLimited.description: More than 30 anonymous demo requests in one minute from this IP; the demo response does not include Retry-After

CounterUnavailable.description: Credit counter temporarily unavailable. Database or query-timeout failures produce 503 only on routes that explicitly handle them.

PaidCounterUnavailable.description: Credit counter temporarily unavailable, or a handled database/query failure; X-Credits-Charged is 0

Change.description: new is a sparse discovery event; updated is a full current active-job snapshot plus updated_at; closed is a sparse closure event with closed_at. Additional Job fields may be present, especially on updated.

file.description: API-relative paths to append to https://api.nivult.com, not filesystem paths

aziende.description: Company field fill rates nested under aziende; no company:* keys
